description: Source code for the implementation of E1AP CU-CP protocol handling, including message processing, UE context management, and procedure invocation within a 3GPP-compliant network component.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_cp_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for E1AP CU-CP protocol handling, managing message processing, UE contexts, and procedures.

classes.name: e1ap_message_notifier_with_logging
classes.description: Helper class that wraps message notifications with logging functionality.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the CU-CP protocol handling, initiating stop procedures.

methods.name: handle_cu_cp_e1_reset_message
methods.description: Processes an E1 Reset message, initiating reset procedures if not stopping.

methods.name: handle_cu_up_e1_setup_response
methods.description: Handles responses to CU-UP E1 setup messages, sending success or failure responses.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_setup_request
methods.description: Processes bearer context setup requests, creating UE contexts and invoking setup procedures.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_modification_request
methods.description: Handles bearer context modification requests, updating UE contexts accordingly.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_release_command
methods.description: Processes bearer context release commands, initiating release procedures.

methods.name: handle_message
methods.description: Main message handler that dispatches incoming E1AP messages based on type.

methods.name: handle_initiating_message
methods.description: Processes initiating E1AP messages, such as setup requests and release requests.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_release_request
methods.description: Handles bearer context release requests from messages.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_inactivity_notification
methods.description: Processes inactivity notifications for bearer contexts, potentially releasing UE.

methods.name: handle_dl_data_notification
methods.description: Handles downlink data notifications, forwarding to CU-CP.

methods.name: handle_successful_outcome
methods.description: Processes successful outcome messages, updating UE context states.

methods.name: handle_unsuccessful_outcome
methods.description: Processes unsuccessful outcome messages, handling failures.

methods.name: cancel_ue_tasks
methods.description: Cancels all ongoing tasks for a specified UE.

methods.name: update_ue_context
methods.description: Transfers UE context from an old to a new UE index.

methods.name: remove_bearer_context
methods.description: Removes UE context from internal list.

methods.name: log_pdu
methods.description: Logs an E1AP PDU, including UE identification.

methods.name: e1ap_message_notifier_with_logging::on_new_message
methods.description: Logs and forwards new incoming messages.
